records.note: No prison-housing data found for transgender prisoners in Azerbaijan. ONE Wikipedia full-text search ('transgender prisoners Azerbaijan') surfaced no source on prison placement of trans people; the 'LGBTQ rights in Azerbaijan' article (fetched, subject-verified; URL https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=LGBTQ_rights_in_Azerbaijan&action=raw) documents police detention and torture of LGBTI individuals during the September 2017 crackdown and harsh general prison conditions, but contains nothing on where trans prisoners are housed: no placement rule (birth sex vs identity), no special units, no solitary/segregation practice, no documented cases or rulings. A further candidate fetch was attempted (Wikipedia API parse) but was rate-limited and returned no content; no loop per lane rules. No other vetted source (HRW/ILGA/ECOM/PRI) was found within the 2-fetch cap with trans-specific prison-housing data for Azerbaijan.

No prison-housing data found for transgender prisoners in Kazakhstan. ONE Wikipedia full-text search ('transgender prisoners Kazakhstan') returned no relevant article. Candidate fetches (subject-verified): ECOM library landing page (https://ecom.ngo/en/library/) is JS-driven with no publication list retrievable as HTML, and ILGA-Europe Annual Review 2025 Kazakhstan chapter (PDF, https://www.ilga-europe.org/files/uploads/2025/02/Annual-Review-2025-Kazakhstan.pdf) documents discrimination, violence, police raids with coerced SOGI disclosure, and legal-gender-recognition barriers for trans people — but neither contains any information on prison housing of trans prisoners: no placement rule (birth sex vs identity), no special units, no solitary/segregation practice, no documented cases or rulings.
